args.question: What is the cardholder statement for this dispute?

args.narrative: The transaction was approved by the issuer (auth code 922519) on 2026-01-14 for the full amount; authorization record and receipt attached.

args.question: Why was the representment rejected? Any new evidence?

args.reason: Authorization approved for the full amount; ledger shows a single capture, so no duplicate charge.

args.explanation: Read the case, both evidence documents and the ledger. Represented with the issuer-approved authorization record (required kind) and receipt. Issuer sent it to pre-arbitration; cardholder says charged twice but the ledger shows a single capture, so I escalated to arbitration. Waited in steps (10, 5, 30 days). Chargeback was reversed in my favour. Fees paid: 1500 chargeback and 2500 pre-arbitration. No refund issued.
